angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 227,703 km at 47.32 pc = 0.06 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 21.1308 +/- 0.0179 mas (same row, RUWE 1.13): 47.32 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.3273 +/- 0.0029 solar radii from Barkaoui et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2015 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract): 227,703 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.3041 +/- 0.0353 solar masses from Barkaoui et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2015 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3297 +/- 14 K from Barkaoui et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2015 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Barkaoui et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2015 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2015.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.891, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): spectral type M4 +/- 0.5, from Barkaoui et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.31 dex, from Barkaoui et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.49214, from Barkaoui et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): age 5.5 Gyr, from Barkaoui et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): rotation period 8.7 d, from Jones et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024AJ....168...93J/abstract)

rotationPeriodsCatalogued.source: VizieR J/AJ/168/234/table10 (Flares & flaring stars from TESS & machine learning), column Prot: 5.91057 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place

projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2015 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2 km/s, from Barkaoui et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...695A.281B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
